sermon.title: Transformation, The Choice - March 10, 2024
sermon.speaker: Unidentified speaker (not clearly Pastor Kincer)
sermon.summary: Satan wants to sift you and break you apart, but Jesus destroyed him as God destroyed Pharaoh’s army. Israel passed through the Red Sea as a baptism, yet still longed for Egypt’s cucumbers, so after deliverance you still have a choice. Choose whom you will serve and become a worshipper like Miriam and David. The service closes with communion.

faqs.question: Don’t you want Jesus praying for you?
How do I know the word is getting in?
faqs.answer: He says he can read four pages and at the end not know what he read.

faqs.question: Was his upbringing normal?
faqs.answer: Mom and dad stayed together and they went to church, which he found out is rare. “Must be California.”

faqs.question: Can I say the devil made me do it?
faqs.answer: No; Jesus has destroyed Satan by His power.

faqs.question: Is Satan hard for God?
faqs.answer: No; Satan is nothing to God.

faqs.question: What does Satan offer when you face a battle?
faqs.answer: We’ll negotiate new terms; it’s going to be different this time.

faqs.question: Are there many gods today?
faqs.answer: Everybody’s got a god; take your pick in America in 2024.

faqs.question: What does the world have?
faqs.answer: A song for every mood: angry, rebellious, partying.

faqs.question: How did David worship?
faqs.answer: Jumping around doing cartwheels before the Lord.

faqs.question: What is heaven doing now?
faqs.answer: Worshiping and lifting up the name of Jesus, and we join them.
